title: Benchmarking Embedding Models for ESG Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.15434v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The use of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) data is fundamental for modern corporate accountability, sustainability reporting, and financial decision-making. Embedding models have emerged as a powerful approach for transforming unstructured ESG text into numerical representations suitable for downstream natural language processing (NLP) tasks. However, their effectiveness in these ESG-specific tasks has not been systematically studied. In this paper, we construct a benchmark dataset specifically tailored to the ESG domain. We benchmark fourteen models, both open-source and closed-source embedding models, comparing their performance with respect to retrieval, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The results demonstrate performance variations across different models, with Qwen3-based models achieving the highest overall performance. This study provides practical insights into which models are better suited for ESG RAG tasks

translated_title: 面向ESG数据的嵌入模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 环境、社会与治理（ESG）数据的使用对于现代企业问责、可持续发展报告和金融决策至关重要。嵌入模型已成为将非结构化ESG文本转化为适用于下游自然语言处理（NLP）任务的数值表示的有力方法。然而，它们在ESG特定任务中的有效性尚未得到系统性研究。本文构建了一个专门针对ESG领域的基准数据集，对十四个开源和闭源嵌入模型进行了基准测试，比较了它们在检索和检索增强生成（RAG）方面的性能。结果表明不同模型之间存在性能差异，其中基于Qwen3的模型取得了最高的整体性能。本研究为哪些模型更适合ESG RAG任务提供了实用的见解。
tldr: 本文构建了首个ESG领域专用基准数据集，系统评测了十四个开源与闭源嵌入模型在检索和RAG任务上的表现，发现基于Qwen3的模型整体性能最优。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs an ESG-specific benchmark dataset and systematically evaluates fourteen open-source and closed-source embedding models on retrieval and RAG tasks, finding that Qwen3-based models achieve the best overall performance.
